notes:
Inbound lead from developer signup. Small marketplace (mid-50s employees) building personalization + chat support for sellers and buyers. Primary ask: hosted API (self-serve) but want explicit answers on how customer prompts/logs are stored and retained.

Key points from call:
- "Do you store customer prompts for more than X days? Can customers opt out?" (quote from Liam, CEO).
- Tech lead Ana: wants per-route retention control, the ability to disable logging for sensitive routes (checkout, payment-related).
- Concerned about prompt snippets appearing in aggregated logs used for debugging. Wants guarantee that customer prompts are not used for model training and an API to purge historical prompts.

Workload profile:
- Chat-based support bot + product recommendation reranking. Burst traffic during promotions (latency target ~ 200-300ms 95th pctl for chat). Throughput modest (peak ~ 8 rps). Cost-sensitive — prefer predictable per-token pricing.

Security questions they pressed on:
- Retention windows: want options 7d / 30d / custom; default retention for hosted needs to be documented.
- Opt-out: ability for customers to opt out of logging/analytics for specific tenants or user cohorts.
- Deletion SLA: need confirmation of timeline once delete call invoked (e.g., 24-72 hours) and audit trail for deletions.
- Residency: prefer NA-only logs for now, may require EU later.

AE notes / friction:
- SMB — unlikely to buy Dedicated early, high chance self-serve conversion if answers are clear and can be published in FAQ.
- Legal wants a short data-retention rider. Suggest sending Redwood hosted retention FAQ + sample DPA snippet.

1) Send short deck explaining hosted API retention defaults, opt-out flags, and deletion API (Ethan by 2026-03-12).
2) SE to prepare a short demo of per-route no-log toggle and show audit log view (Priya) — schedule week of 2026-03-15.
3) Provide suggested language for Moonbeam's privacy policy and DPA to speed legal review.
